threads.body: `SemconvStability.v3Preview()` is derived from `GlobalOpenTelemetry` declarative config, so it may not reflect the `openTelemetry` instance being configured here (and may not reflect the flat `otel.instrumentation.common.v3-preview` property in the standalone-library fallback path). That can cause the deprecated `otel.instrumentation.common.db-statement-sanitizer.enabled` fallback to still be consulted even when users believe v3-preview is enabled. Consider deriving `v3Preview` from the passed `openTelemetry` common config with a flat-property fallback, and use that boolean to decide whether to skip the deprecated key.

threads.body: `getCommonQuerySanitizationEnabled()` already has access to the `commonConfig` derived from the passed `openTelemetry`, but it gates deprecated alias reads on `SemconvStability.v3Preview()` (which is computed from `GlobalOpenTelemetry`). This can diverge from the `openTelemetry` instance being queried and lead to deprecated aliases still being read even when `commonConfig` has `v3_preview` enabled. Prefer checking `commonConfig.getBoolean("v3_preview", false)` here so the behavior is consistent with the provided `OpenTelemetry`.
